subject: Engineering Fundamentals
title: The Beijing Daxing Airport: Starfish Terminal
description: A quick win: understand The Beijing Daxing Airport: Starfish Terminal.

hook.text: Beijing Daxing has the world's largest single terminal. Its starfish shape means no gate is more than an 8-minute walk away.

buildup.text: Designed by Zaha Hadid, the terminal spans 7.5 million square feet. Its roof is a single continuous structure with no columns.

discovery.text: The radial layout funnels passengers through a central hub. Five concourses branch out like fingers, serving different flights.

twist.text: The entire airport was built in under five years — groundbreaking to opening. Comparable Western projects take 10 to 15 years.

climax.text: It can handle 72 million passengers annually and is designed to expand to 100 million. It's a city-scale infrastructure project.

punchline.text: 7.5 million square feet. No columns. Eight-minute walk. Five years to build.

quiz.question: What structural feat makes Daxing's terminal roof remarkable?
options: The roof is made entirely of recycled glass that generates solar power
It has a single continuous structure with no internal columns across 7.5 million square feet
The roof opens mechanically to allow fresh air circulation throughout the terminal
